value.body: A science degree in collecting, analysing and drawing conclusions from data: probability, distributions, sampling, statistical inference, regression, design of experiments and statistical computing, usually alongside Mathematics. It leads to analytics, research, government statistics and actuarial work.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in the science stream, usually with Mathematics (usually required). Central universities (Delhi University, BHU and others) admit through CUET-UG scores in the relevant subjects; many state universities and their colleges admit on Class 12 merit or a state test. You usually choose the major — or a combination of two or three subjects — at admission. The Indian Statistical Institute's B.Stat (Hons) is a separate degree with its own entrance test.

value.title: At a glance
items: Fewer colleges offer Statistics as a major than Mathematics or Physics.
Analytics and data roles hire statistics graduates, especially with R, Python or SQL skills.
UPSC's Indian Statistical Service accepts graduates with Statistics as a subject (or a master's); state statistics departments also recruit.
IIT JAM (Mathematical Statistics paper), ISI's M.Stat and CUET-PG lead to master's programmes.
